page.content:
Draconequus of chaos who later befriends Fluttershy.

How Discord connects

  • Faction: Mane Six — The Mane Six first imprison Discord, then befriend him.
  • Character: Fluttershy — Fluttershy's friendship is what keeps Discord from remaking Equestria.

What is Discord?

Discord is the spirit of chaos the Mane Six first stone, then reform: a mismatched draconequus whose friendship with Fluttershy keeps him from remaking Equestria as a gag.

Key threads lead to Mane Six and Fluttershy.
